text: Home FAQ Contact Us Login Login with JanParichay e-Forensic 1.0 Welcome Digitizing Forensic Labs for Efficiency and Accuracy Welcome to a revolutionary platform designed to automate forensic lab operations. Our portal helps forensic labs connect seamlessly with police, courts, and other key agencies, ensuring fast, secure, and transparent workflows from case registration to report dispatch. Key Features Automated Workflows Speed up the forensic process with fully automated workflows. Seamless Data Sharing Easily share reports and data with police and courts. Real-Time Dashboard Stay updated on case status, report readiness, and more with a powerful dashboard. How It Works A seamless, step-by-step process to manage and monitor forensic cases with ease and efficiency. Login Securely log into the portal with your credentials to access your personalized dashboard and case management tools. Registration Quickly search for specific cases or reports using advanced filters. Easily locate case details, status updates, and relevant documents in seconds. Report Submission Track the progress of your cases in real-time. Receive automated updates on task completion, ensuring every step is on time and nothing is overlooked. Analyze & Track Track case status, report readiness, and dispatch timelines in real-time. Monitor case progress and key updates to ensure timely action at every stage. Monitor via Dashboard Monitor overall case status, report readiness, and dispatch timelines through a centralized dashboard. Get a clear view of case progress and stay informed from start to finish. Contact Us Phone Number 24x7 NIC Service Desk 1800 111 555 E-Mail Address servicedesk.nic.in Headquarters Ministry of Home Affairs, Kartavya Bhavan 3, Central Secretariat New Delhi - 110001 Get Direction Other Address National Crime Records Bureau National Highway - 8, Near SSB, Mahipalpur - 110037 E-Mail : dct[at]ncrb[dot]nic[dot]in © Content Owned by Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India | Site Maintained by (NIC) National Informatics Center Version: 2.0.0.1, Released Date: 17/06/2026 11:30AM
